cohort: 295 participants undergoing cesarean section under spinal anesthesia in two tertiary care hospitals in Peshawar, Pakistan.
finding: The incidence of intraoperative shivering was 43.1%, and was associated with body mass index, maternal comorbidities, room temperature, premedication, duration of preoperative fasting, and bupivacaine dose in multivariate analysis, and with type of fluid, oxygen saturation, oxytocin dose, and nausea in bivariate analysis.
